text:
Alice C: Anyone else seeing a sustained tail-latency bump in eu-dedicated? spikes started ~20m ago, p95 up ~60ms even though QPS steady. dashboard: slot_util=98%, evictions climbing.
Ben O: I noticed a flurry of kernel fallback logs on several hosts: `kernel_select: fallback to generic_kernel due to incompatible cuBLAS` — that can add jitter.
Carol N: KV cache hitrate also tanked around the same time — dropped from 0.78 -> 0.22. Eviction churn looks correlated.
Dave P: Quick pprof from runtime on an affected node (snippet):
```
profiles: cpu
total 100s
- kernel_switch        35.2s
- batching             20.5s
- kv_cache_lock        15.1s
- io/sys               12.0s
- other                17.2s
```
Dave P: batching histogram skewed to small batches (1-2) which increases per-token overhead.
infra-bot: quota-change audit: id=aq-8943 user=ops@oncall target=eu1 committed_slots 120->80 at 1723456650. See https://infra.audit/aq-8943
Alice C: That quota reduction would explain saturation + evictions -> noisy-neighbor pressure. The kernel fallback might be from recent node image update that mismatches cuBLAS; combined effect amplifies latency.
Ben O: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback the quota change for the affected pool 2) relax placement affinity to spread tenants 3) temporarily force preferred kernels on patched hosts (`--kernel-prefer=opt_kv`)
Carol N: Also propose temporarily bumping KV cache size on those hosts: set `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_MB=1024` (was 512) to reduce eviction churn while we stabilize.
Dave P: I'll prepare the node patch and rolling restart; will monitor kernel_select logs during restarts.
Alice C: Assignments: @Ben O roll back quota + adjust placement, @Dave P roll nodes/patch kernel selection, @Carol N bump KV env and watch hitrate. If no improvement in 15m escalate to SLA incident.
Ben O: Rolled back quota at 1723456790. Confirmed committed_slots -> 120. Evictions count started decreasing :thumbsup:
Carol N: KV hitrate recovering: 0.22 -> 0.65 after env bump and fewer evictions.
Dave P: Patch applied to 6/8 hosts, restarted runtime. No further kernel fallback logs on patched hosts. Batching sizes are trending back to normal.
Alice C: Good work. Next steps: postmortem to cover (a) quota-change validation & approval guardrail, (b) canary for node images to catch cuBLAS/kernel mismatches, (c) add alert for sudden KV hitrate drops.
Ben O: I'll file the incident ticket and include the profiling snippets + audit link.
Carol N: Happy to owner the KV follow-up.
Dave P: Monitoring for 30m then close.
Alice C: Closing updates here; thanks all. :tada:
